t: Flomasta copper end feed fitting reducers are essential components for plumbing and heating installations, designed to connect pipes of different diameters securely. These durable copper reducers are ideal for adapting pipework in domestic and commercial settings, such as connecting a 15mm main pipe to a 10mm branch line in a central heating system or hot water supply. The end feed system ensures reliable, leak-free joints when soldered, providing a robust solution for various pipe connection requirements. This two-pack offers convenience for professional plumbers and heating engineers working on diverse projects.
